items.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
items.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

items.overview: During the Kadamba reign, King Vijayendra, the ruler of the fictional feudatory land of Bangra, meets his final fate while venturing into the mystical forest of Kantara. items.title: Thota Kovi
items.overview: A witty crime-drama set in the western ghats of Karnataka.

items.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
items.overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.

items.title: KD – The Devil
items.overview: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

items.title: Lava Kusha
items.overview: Lava Kusha is a 2007 Kannada film directed by Om Saiprakash. The film stars Upendra, Shivaraj Kumar, Charmi Kaur and Jennifer Kotwal in lead roles. Music was composed by Gurukiran.

items.title: Nanne Preethse: I Love You
items.overview: When Santu meets Dharmika after few years of romantic college life, will he win the lost love, or is there something surprise round the corner.

items.title: UI
items.overview: Set in a fictional world, the story is about the psychological conflict between a king in a town and an extraordinary man, and how that man, through his cunning and master minded plans takes over everything, takes control of the entire town, becomes a dictator.

items.title: Simple Agi Ondh Love Story
items.overview: Rachana persuades her brother to meet her boyfriend's sister, Ithihasini, hoping that cupid would strike them. However, things take a turn when another girl tricks him into falling in love with her.

items.title: Gruha Pravesha
items.overview: Jyothi is all set to marry her fiance, Sridhar, chosen by her parents. But in a cruel twist of fate, she is forced to marry Venu, a jealous college mate, who assaulted her.

items.title: Amara Jyothi
items.overview: The film is a family drama about a man whose past love causes problems in his current relationship and leads to misunderstandings.

items.title: Avala Neralu
items.overview: Raja returns to his hometown from America and finds out that his father died in a mysterious jeep accident. Not convinced with the facts, he starts to dig deep into his father's death.

items.title: Aapadbandhava
items.overview: A man, depressed by the death of his own family, finds a boy with speech and hearing impairment in the trash. The boy, who has seen the killers of his widowed mother, is in danger.

items.title: Dandupalya 3
items.overview: Director Srinivas Raju’s world of Dandupalya, as seen in the first two films of the series, will finally come to an end. The third film in the series will mark the end of the franchise, which has received a great deal of critical acclaim in both Kannada and Telugu.

items.title: 777 Charlie
items.overview: Dharma is stuck in a rut with his negative and lonely lifestyle and spends each day in the comfort of his loneliness. A pup named Charlie who is naughty and energetic which is a complete contrast with the Dharma’s character enters his life and gives him a new perspective towards it.
